title: Force rebuild and redeploy all latest changes (Our Legacy page, nav link, brand name, build fixes)

requirements.text: Ensure the OurLegacy page component is fully and correctly defined at frontend/src/pages/OurLegacy.tsx with: (1) a clean brand heritage intro section connecting Nexiris Global to its roots via Nexiris Consultants, using the Frost White + Minty Blue palette with Montserrat headings and Inter body copy; (2) a prominent primary CTA button labelled 'View Firm Profile' that opens https://www.nexirisconsultants.com/_files/ugd/9b0883_a8ad90d67710468a9bdab66b562c8b7a.pdf in a new tab; (3) a secondary link/button labelled 'Visit Nexiris Consultants' that opens https://www.nexirisconsultants.com in a new tab. The page must use the existing Layout wrapper (Navigation + Footer).

quotes: the Our Legacy page, navigation link, Firm Profile CTA, brand name updates

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /our-legacy renders the OurLegacy page without errors
'View Firm Profile' button opens the PDF URL in a new tab
'Visit Nexiris Consultants' link opens https://www.nexirisconsultants.com in a new tab
Page uses Montserrat headings and Inter body copy
Page uses Frost White background and Minty Blue accents consistently

requirements.text: Ensure the /our-legacy route is correctly registered in App.tsx within the TanStack Router configuration as a child route of the Layout route, importing OurLegacy from the correct path. Verify no TypeScript or import errors exist in App.tsx.

quotes: the Our Legacy page, navigation link, Firm Profile CTA, brand name updates

acceptanceCriteria: App.tsx compiles without TypeScript errors
The /our-legacy route resolves to the OurLegacy page component
Existing routes (/, /annual-program) continue to function correctly

requirements.text: Ensure Navigation.tsx includes an 'Our Legacy' navigation link alongside 'Home' and 'Pricing', navigating to /our-legacy via the client-side router with the same active/hover Minty Blue styling as other nav links. Verify Navigation.tsx compiles without errors.

quotes: the Our Legacy page, navigation link, Firm Profile CTA, brand name updates

acceptanceCriteria: Navigation bar displays 'Home', 'Pricing', and 'Our Legacy' links
Clicking 'Our Legacy' navigates to /our-legacy
Active/hover state on 'Our Legacy' link uses Minty Blue accent
Navigation.tsx compiles without TypeScript errors

requirements.text: Ensure all company name references across the entire codebase are consistently 'Nexiris Global' — not 'Nexiris Global Pvt Ltd', 'Nexiris Consultants LLP', or 'Nexiris Consultants'. This includes Navigation.tsx logo alt text, Footer.tsx company name and disclaimer, frontend/index.html title tag, meta description, og:title, og:description, og:site_name, Twitter Card tags, JSON-LD structured data name and description fields, and all in-component text in HeroSection.tsx, PricingSection.tsx, FAQSection.tsx, AnnualProgramSection.tsx, CredibilitySection.tsx, FinalCTASection.tsx, InquiryModal.tsx. Do not modify immutable files.
acceptanceCriteria: No occurrence of 'Nexiris Consultants LLP', 'Nexiris Consultants', or 'Nexiris Global Pvt Ltd' appears in any non-immutable file
All user-facing text and meta tags display 'Nexiris Global'
frontend/index.html title and meta tags reference 'Nexiris Global'

requirements.text: Audit and resolve all TypeScript compilation errors across the frontend. Specifically: (1) ensure HowItWorksSection.tsx is either a complete, valid component or its import is removed from Home.tsx — it must not be imported if empty or broken; (2) fix any broken imports in Navigation.tsx, Footer.tsx, HeroSection.tsx, and all page components; (3) resolve any type mismatches in useQueries.ts and InquiryModal.tsx; (4) ensure the Motoko backend actor in backend/main.mo compiles without errors. The entire project must build and deploy successfully.

quotes: rebuild and redeploy with all the latest changes cleanly applied

acceptanceCriteria: Frontend builds with zero TypeScript errors or warnings that block compilation
backend/main.mo compiles without errors
All page routes render correctly in the deployed application
No broken imports remain in any component file

requirements.text: Ensure the Nexiris logo image renders correctly in both Navigation.tsx (navbar, left side) and Footer.tsx (appropriately smaller size). The src must point to '/assets/generated/nexiris-logo.png'. Verify this path resolves at runtime in the deployed environment.

quotes: the Our Legacy page, navigation link, Firm Profile CTA, brand name updates, and everything else

acceptanceCriteria: Logo is visible in the sticky navbar on the left side
Logo is visible in the footer at a smaller size
No broken image icon appears for the logo in either location
The src attribute value is '/assets/generated/nexiris-logo.png'

constraints: Do not modify any immutable files: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
All Motoko logic must remain in backend/main.mo single actor
Use TanStack Router for all client-side routing
nonGoals: Adding new product features or sections not already in the project state
Changing the existing Frost White + Minty Blue colour palette
Modifying the backend data model or inquiry submission logic
